faq.q: How do I give the agents the old URL list?
faq.a: Upload a CSV of old URLs, with the new URL beside each one where you have it. Export it from your old sitemap, Search Console, or your analytics tool.

faq.q: Can it run on staging before the cutover?
faq.a: Yes. Point the agents at the staging site and the old URL list. Fix the misses, then run a rescan on the live domain after DNS switches.
Any platform to any platform. Webflow to Webflow and WordPress to Webflow are the most common. The agents read the sites, not the CMS.
